name: Bright Telecommunications
summary: WA state-government (Western Power) telecom arm; Perth metropolitan fibre network branded Bright; sold to Silk Telecom 2006 (later Nextgen) (NEXTGEN TELECOM (WA) PTY LTD, ACN 103 173 440).

events.details: NEXTGEN TELECOM (WA) PTY LTD, ACN 103 173 440 (State Government private company), registered 1 Feb 2003; trading names Bright Telecommunications / Bright / Bright Broadband etc. Western Power (WA) telecom arm, Perth.
Bright business sold to Silk Telecom (Perth metro fibre). Silk Telecom was in turn acquired by Nextgen Networks in 2008 (the company was renamed NEXTGEN TELECOM (WA) PTY LTD).

The domain bright.net.au is an unrelated parked/sponsored-listing page (from at least 2017) and is not this entity's homepage; the operating company's ABN 89 103 173 440 is now named NEXTGEN TELECOM (WA) PTY LTD.
